map.→ 打开光弹性应力分析工具: -> Open the photoelastic stress analysis tool
map.应力过大易崩边/畸变。: Too much stress causes edge chipping and distortion.
map.按偏振光条纹级数估算透明件内部应力差（σ₁-σ₂=N·f/d），用于光弹性应力检: Estimate the internal stress difference in a transparent part from the polarised fringe order (σ₁-σ₂=N·f/d), for photoelastic stress inspection as a pure front-end reading aid.
map.装配后偏光镜下看应力斑判装配合格。: After assembly, look at the stress fringes under a polariser to judge whether the fit is acceptable.
map.装配过紧产生双折射与畸变，长期可致镜片开裂，尤其 PC/高折片敏感。: Over-tight assembly produces birefringence and distortion and can crack the lens long term, especially PC and high-index lenses.
map.需偏光片+标准光源，肉眼看不出，门店用应力仪客观判级。: Requires a polariser and a standard light source; the naked eye cannot see it, so stores use a stress instrument for objective grading.
map.：偏光镜观察无彩色条纹/局部亮斑=合格；边缘明显彩纹=装夹过紧，需松框重装以免长: : under a polariser, no coloured fringes or local bright spots means acceptable; obvious coloured fringes at the edge mean the frame is too tight and needs loosening and refitting to avoid long-term stress chipping.
map.：应力等级 0–3，≤1 合格、2 需复检、3 不合格；塑料架比金属架更易过夹，: : stress grade 0-3, <=1 pass, 2 needs re-inspection, 3 fail; plastic frames are more prone to over-clamping than metal, so control the torque.
